description: PINNED XFAIL on impl#1 (g-client-template-interpolation-lowering-needs-a-structural-emitter, carried): this case states the CORRECT behaviour. S437 round 5's client template lowering was reverted before landing because it silently miscompiled other templates; the structural fix is its own arc. S437 round 5 F2 (root): a template literal reading cells (`${@r}`, `${@o.n}`, a nested template) inside an ordinary FUNCTION BODY. The client structured emitter kept the template's `raw` verbatim, so `@r` reached the JS and the build failed E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC — on base too.
rationale: A `${@cell}` inside a template literal in logic context is a cell read (§6, §5.2.3 statement grammar = function body).
